description: This file defines a WrappedRange class for handling text ranges in a rich text editor, including methods for creating, manipulating, and querying ranges, with support for different browser APIs.

classes.name: WrappedRange
classes.description: A class representing a range in the document, with methods for range manipulation, selection, and content editing.

methods.name: nativeRange
methods.description: Returns the native DOM Range or TextRange object based on browser support.

methods.name: getPoints
methods.description: Returns the start and end points of the range.

methods.name: getStartPoint
methods.description: Returns the start boundary point of the range.

methods.name: getEndPoint
methods.description: Returns the end boundary point of the range.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects the range in the document, updating the current selection.

methods.name: scrollIntoView
methods.description: Scrolls the container to bring the start of the range into view.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes the range to ensure it is on visible and valid points.

methods.name: nodes
methods.description: Returns nodes within the range that satisfy a predicate.

methods.name: commonAncestor
methods.description: Returns the common ancestor element of the range.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands the range to include ancestor nodes satisfying a predicate.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapses the range to its start or end point.

methods.name: splitText
methods.description: Splits text nodes at the range boundaries.

methods.name: deleteContents
methods.description: Deletes the contents within the range.

methods.name: makeIsOn
methods.description: Returns a function to check if the range is on a node satisfying a predicate.

methods.name: isLeftEdgeOf
methods.description: Checks if the range's start point is at the left edge of a node satisfying a predicate.

methods.name: isCollapsed
methods.description: Checks if the range is collapsed (start and end points are the same).

methods.name: wrapBodyInlineWithPara
methods.description: Wraps inline nodes with paragraph tags if necessary.

methods.name: insertNode
methods.description: Inserts a node at the current range position.

methods.name: pasteHTML
methods.description: Inserts HTML content at the current range position.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the text content of the range.

methods.name: getWordRange
methods.description: Returns a range covering the word before the cursor.

methods.name: bookmark
methods.description: Creates an offsetPath bookmark of the range.

methods.name: paraBookmark
methods.description: Creates a paragraph-based offsetPath bookmark.
